# MyStack Framework

> Official repository: https://github.com/mystack-framework/mystack
> Documentation: https://mystack-framework.github.io/mystack/
> License: Apache-2.0

MyStack is a zero-Composer PHP full-stack framework. Executable code in library/, src/js/PHJS-min.php and mystack is authoritative. Never invent APIs; verify exact signatures.

## Canonical resources
- AGENTS.md: agent contract
- README.md: overview
- MANUAL_BN.md: detailed Bangla manual
- docs/api.json: machine API catalog
